ops.title: Bind known-branch stack operations to their own trunk
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Source audit at current143716 shows infoGTStack, gtStackUpTo, gtStackChain and gtRestackChain still select an arbitrary Trunk entry from a mixed native/legacy state despite having a known branch or chain. gtDownstack now ends at any trunk, which masks several traversal symptoms but cannot correct the reported trunk or replay pin. Next: preserve existing mixed-provider fixture, isolate deterministic regression for reported trunk/replay base, replace only proven known-branch selections with existing gtTrunkForBranch, then independent source review and CI. No host operation, local tests or timeout change.

ops.text: The unchanged mixed-root regression fails before the fix and passes after it while retaining unknown-branch diagnostics.
Independent source review and required CI cover branch-specific reporting, target filtering, and actual replay pin; merge and official release include the reviewed bytes.
Eligible public CLI is installed under the root runtime slot and one bounded affected-case operation verifies correct branch trunk with preserved sessions.
